record.question: The child with asthma should be free of wheezing for at least several days before surgery, even if this necessitates an increase in β-agonist dosage and the addition of steroids. Of the following, the MOST appropriate preoperative steroids regime in children with asthma (who are receiving asthma therapy or who have received steroid within the last year) is
options: prednisone, 1 mg/kg given 24 and 12 hr before surgery
prednisone, 2 mg/kg given 24 and 12 hr before surgery
dexamethasone, 0.6 mg/kg given 24 and 12 hr before surgery
hydrocortisone IV, 5 mg/kg given 24 and 12 hr before surgery
